description: Rebalance a multi-currency portfolio: given holdings, per-holding (or per-asset-class) target weights, cash and FX rates, return the exact BUY/SELL trades to reach the targets, the per-currency cash movements (flagging foreign-cash overdrafts), and a summary. It is the same plan the RetireCrunch Portfolio Rebalancer page makes: class goals drive holdings (locked holdings stay put, target_mode "custom" holdings keep their target_pct, the rest share the class goal pro-rata to value), with an optional buy-only mode, tolerance band and new money. The verdict says why there are trades or none (onTarget, locked, belowMinimum, …). Planning math only — no transaction costs or taxes.

available_cash.description: Cash held per currency, keyed by ISO code.

base_currency.description: Base currency the portfolio is valued in.

class_targets.description: Optional per-asset-class goal % of the whole portfolio (incl. "Cash"). Inside a class with a goal, locked holdings stay put, target_mode "custom" holdings keep their target_pct, and the rest share what is left pro-rata to current value. Classes without a goal trade to their holdings' own target_pct.

fx_rates.description: Value of 1 unit of each currency in the base currency (base currency itself is 1).

asset_class.description: Equity, Bond, Cash, Real estate, Commodity, Alternative, Crypto or Other.

cost_basis.description: Average acquisition price per unit (for P/L only).

currency.description: ISO currency code the instrument trades in (e.g. "USD").

locked.description: Pin to current weight — never traded.

multiplier.description: Units of the underlying one quantity unit stands for (default 1): 100 for a US equity option, 0.01 for a bond quoted in % of par. Value = quantity × price × multiplier.

price.description: Current price per unit, in the holding currency.

sec_type.description: Broker security type (STK, OPT, BOND, BILL …). BOND and BILL trade in 1,000-face steps.

target_mode.description: Only matters inside a class that has a goal in class_targets. "auto" (default): the holding shares what is left of the class goal with the other auto holdings, pro-rata to current value, and its target_pct is ignored. "custom": the holding keeps its own target_pct.

target_pct.description: Target weight as % of the whole portfolio (incl. cash).

mode.description: "rebalance" (default): buy and sell to reach the targets. "buyOnly": never sell; spend only the cash above the cash target, spread evenly over the under-weight holdings.

new_money.description: New money to invest, in base_currency (default 0). Added to base-currency cash before the plan is made.

tolerance_pts.description: Tolerance band in percentage points (default 0). A class within this many points of its goal is not traded. Needs class_targets.

name: rebalance_portfolio
